# Unite Group

> Unite Group (Unite-Group Nexus Pty Ltd) is an online business serving Australia and New Zealand. Unite-Group Nexus is the CRM and operating system we are building to run the businesses behind it. Its first offer on sale is the video business card: one link or QR code that plays a short film ending on your logo, then shows your details and saves to contacts in one tap.

## What is on sale

- Video business card, Ready-made: $249 AUD, one-off price, GST included. You pick one of the ready-made films and it ends on your logo and details.
- Video business card, Made for you: $449 AUD, one-off price, GST included. We make a film for your business and you approve a private proof before it goes live.
- There is no subscription. The example films on the showroom are AI-generated and labelled as such.
- A hosting term has not been set yet. Ask in writing before relying on one.
